reply_text:
I answered Hollis in a thread on their #central-random message: the Door 6 gatehouse tablet freeze at Tansleigh Packaging is **ticket #88412**.

That number comes from a #central-team conversation on Jul 2, 2025, and Hollis is a member of that channel. In it, Tobias Rendle raised the Tier 2 escalation: the scanner app froze on the BOL barcode scan when a driver arrived with a split manifest. The thread briefly mixed up Tansleigh Packaging with Tansley Parcel, but Tobias confirmed #88412 is the Tansleigh Packaging ticket.

I found no ticket files for the account in the shared files, so this chat is the only record of the number I could see.
